name: Import
description: Importers that read the vector formats export writes, its inverse, both built: SVGImport.scene reads an SVG document into one scene and LottieImport.document reads a Lottie JSON document into a document, each with byte, element, layer and depth caps, a typed ImportError and an ImportReport listing what was skipped. The SVG reader walks XMLTokens, the bounded, Linux-safe XML tokenizer (tags, attributes, text, entities; comments, declarations and CDATA skipped), reads path data with SVGPathData (every command, absolute and relative, arcs as cubics) and cascades fill, stroke, opacity and font properties from attributes and style with SVGStyle; it turns basic shapes and paths, with their transforms baked in, solid and gradient fills (href chains followed with a visited set), strokes, clip paths as layer masks and text as text shapes into one layer per top-level drawable, counting every other element and each reference cycle as skipped. The Lottie reader (LottieImport, with its animation half) turns shape and solid layers, their paths, rectangles, ellipses, fills, strokes, gradients and transforms into one scene, with keyframes (easings from the file's handles, holds) as position, scale, rotation, opacity, colour, stroke width and shape tracks, masks as layer masks and tt as track mattes, counting parents, expressions, keyed anchors, group transforms and other layer kinds as skipped. ImportNumber is the exact fast decimal path (Clinger's) that SVGPathData and the Lottie JSON reader try before Double(String).
